name: Reconciliation Criteria 1 Code
definition: Available criterion to group transactions when a reconliation is made.

BRND.name: Card Brand
BRND.definition: The set is defined by transactions made with cards belonging  to the same brand.

PROF.name: Card Product Profile
PROF.definition: The set is defined by transactions made with cards sharing the same CardProductProfile.

GRUP.name: Poi Group
GRUP.definition: The set is defined by transactions processed by POIs identified with the same POIGroup.
